title: Drawing and Painting
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Take rubbings outside on bark, leaves, coins and walls. Brushes: one per colour pot, washed between colours.

skills.key_step: The child says texture is how a surface feels, names rough, smooth and bumpy surfaces, and says how a rubbing shows texture.

floor.question: Name one thing you colour with.

representations: crayons with the paper peeled off
steps: Rub with the side of the crayon.
contexts: a nature walk in the school compound

board.do: What will a rubbing of it show?
The bumpy pattern of the weave.

misconceptions.ask: What is the texture of tree bark?
misconceptions.repair: Close your eyes and touch the bark: what does it feel like?

listen_for: rough, because it is not shiny
misconceptions.ask: Is a plastic plate rough or smooth?
misconceptions.repair: Rub fingers over a matt plastic plate and a stone.

misconceptions.ask: Which part of the crayon do you use for a rubbing?
misconceptions.repair: Peel a crayon and rub with its side over a leaf.

misconceptions.ask: Which paper is best for a rubbing?
misconceptions.repair: Rub the same coin under card and under thin paper.

checks.question: What is the texture of a stone wall?
Which part of the crayon do you rub with?

skills.key_step: The child names regular shapes and says how to paint them neatly: dip the tip, wipe, stroke in one direction, wash between colours.

floor.question: What do you hold to paint with a brush?

contexts: painting a flag for a school event
a shape picture for the class wall

board.do: Dip only the tip and wipe.

listen_for: all of it, up to the handle
misconceptions.ask: How much of the brush do you dip into the paint?
misconceptions.repair: Show a dripping brush and a brush dipped at the tip.

misconceptions.ask: You finish with red and want yellow. What do you do first?
misconceptions.repair: Put a red brush in yellow and watch it turn orange.

misconceptions.ask: How many sides does a triangle have?
misconceptions.repair: Count the sides of a triangle with a finger: one, two, three.

listen_for: scrub it back and forth hard
misconceptions.ask: How do you move the brush to paint a shape neatly?
misconceptions.repair: Show a scrubbed shape (torn paper) next to a smooth one.

checks.question: What do you do before taking a new colour?
How many sides has a rectangle?
